description: React component for the Mattermost admin console's server logs page, including log fetching, filtering, pagination, and display.

classes.name: Logs
classes.description: React component managing the server logs view in the admin console, including log retrieval, filtering, pagination, and display.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state with default values and props.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Triggers log data reload when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Reloads logs if pagination changes or plain logs are empty.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of logs.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page of logs.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches logs based on current filters and log format.

methods.name: onLogFormatToggle
methods.description: Handles toggling between JSON and plain text log formats.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search term and triggers filtering.

methods.name: performSearch
methods.description: Filters logs based on search input, excluding 'level' and 'timestamp' fields.

methods.name: onFiltersChange
methods.description: Updates filter criteria and reloads logs.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the logs page with filters, toggle, and log list components.

search-terms: plain vs JSON log format toggle
